clean.tx: He hoki mai ki uta, kai iri ki te hakanonoŋa.
clean.tl: They returned inland, they did not go out to the hakanononga fishing zones.

clean.tx: Kai pāhono e Hotu i tū vānaŋa era a Tahoŋa.
clean.tl: Hotu did not reply to those words of Tahonga.

clean.tx: ¿He aha rā ia ina hoi koe kai kī mai?
clean.tl: Why then didn’t you tell me?
